audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions are missing entirely. Alpha Strike makes Yi untargetable while it travels, so a commit thrown into it is simply lost — and its cooldown shortens with every basic attack he lands, so it is not a fixed 20-second window. Meditate is a channel that any CC cancels, which means Flawless Duet turns his sustain button into a wasted 10-second cooldown. Wuju Style grants bonus TRUE damage, so the page's implicit 'out-stat him' framing ignores that armour does nothing about his primary damage. Highlander makes him immune to slows, which matters because Vanguard's Edge's wall is a slow.
audit.why: The R interaction is the one that will surprise a player mid-fight: dropping the wall to kite a Highlander Yi does not slow him at all. The stun still lands, the terrain still blocks — the slow does not.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike's untargetability and attack-driven cooldown added to early; the E-cancels-Meditate interaction added to whys[2] and spikes[1]; Wuju Style's true damage added to whys[5] and spikes[2]; Highlander's slow immunity added in the created spikes[3] and in late.
